title: Kargathia Keep
wikitext:
[[File:Kargathia Keep.jpg|thumb|Kargathia Keep]]

'''Kargathia Keep''' (or Kargathia Outpost)<ref>''[[World of Warcraft: Game Manual]]''</ref> is located in eastern [[Ashenvale]], in the eastern part of the [[Warsong Lumber Camp]] just west of the [[Southfury River]]. It is the base of operations for the officers of the [[Warsong Clan]], and has a strategic position that lets it receive reinforcements from [[Orgrimmar]] should a battle with the [[Alliance]] break out. The keep, much like [[Kargath]] in the [[Badlands]], and [[Bladefist Bay]] in [[Durotar]], is named for the legendary orcish hero [[Kargath Bladefist]].
